_comment: Confirmed MissionChief mechanics. 'source' is provenance, exactly as in prices.json. build_menu and player_report are the player's own screen and are treated as truth; everything else must be re-verified. See docs/VERIFICATION.md.

concurrent_mission_cap.value: count of the most-built building type, +1
concurrent_mission_cap.note: Usually fire stations. This is why the planner ranks the highest-paying mission rather than the number of missions unlocked.

mission_spawn_model.value: a call picks a building and spawns inside that building's range
mission_spawn_model.note: Requirements are local, not global. An extension on a building lets THAT building spawn special calls.

specialisation.value: a specialised station generates only its specialised calls
specialisation.note: The game's own path mechanism. Not in the dataset; see SPEC-1 and SPEC-2 in docs/VERIFICATION.md.

requirements_count.note: Each building type spawns its own kind of call.

listed_credits.value: the listed figure is what you receive
listed_credits.note: A range means the mission spawns at various intensities, which is why one mission name appears several times in the dataset.

completion_gate.value: every required vehicle present, with correctly trained personnel
completion_gate.note: No partial credit. Unlocking a mission is not the same as being able to earn from it.

alliance_payout.value: every participant receives the full amount
alliance_payout.note: A 2,000-credit alliance mission pays 2,000 to each player, even one who sent a single vehicle.

hospitals.value: gate no mission; patient transport is free
hospitals.note: Hospitals are not unlock items and are therefore not in the ladder. What a transport PAYS is still unknown - see EMS-1.

poi.value: free and effectively unlimited, but must sit inside your own coverage area
poi.note: 629 of 1,261 missions are gated behind a POI. The planner shows the POI but does not price it.

spawn_rate.value: continuous up to the cap; timing looks random
spawn_rate.note: Understaffed stations cause low-credit phases. Player's rule: fill a small station to its maximum vehicles before building the next one.

dispatch_centers.value: 1 + 1 per 15 buildings, dispatch centers not counted
dispatch_centers.note: Free to build. The official help centre still says 1 per 25; that figure is wrong.

small_stations.value: count identically toward requirements, hold 6 vehicles and one extension, cost half
small_stations.note: Upgrading to a full station costs the difference and takes 24 hours. Exact figures unconfirmed.
